name: D1_decay
substitutes: geometry.disc_halfwidth_pc 100: DRAGON2 has no thin-disc parameter; its gas has its own scale heights (BronfFerr: H2 59 pc, HI 115 pc at the observer)
gas 'uniform, n_H = 1 cm^-3': BronfFerr (analytic HI and H2, HII 0); DRAGON2's 'Uniform' gas is not implemented in cd588707 (gas.cc writes -1)
gas He_to_H_number 0.1: DRAGON2's fixed helium (He/H 0.11, constants.h) with its He_to_H_CS_ratio scaling of every production cross section
sources.spatial: OneRing, uniform in R from 0 to the radial boundary (DRAGON2's z profile of the ring)
decay half-lives of ['4010', '6014']: NUBASE2020 (core.constants.physical), replacing DRAGON2's isotope_list.dat values (10Be 1.51 Myr there)
inelastic cross sections: DRAGON2's own parametrization (not replaceable through its data files)
sources.injection spectrum_variable 'rigidity': DRAGON2's own measure (R^-gamma per unit momentum, gamma 2.3, eta 0), translated exactly
sources.abundances 'dragon2:BaseModel_DRAGONxsec.source.param': the source abundances of DRAGON2's BaseModel_DRAGONxsec.source.param, kept (propagated O/C 1.19-1.21 at 10 GeV/n, VALIDATION CRPROP-D3)

sources.spatial: not fixed by harmonized-v1; each code records its choice

cross_sections.ghost_threshold: off: ghost nuclei and tertiary chains off on both sides
